author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

In order to address https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51757, this PR first adds unit tests for `edm::FileInPath`. While generating the test code my AI agent discovered 3 more corner cases that are not handled well, and this PR fixes those too. I then asked the AI agent to create tests for more corner cases, which it did, and that are fixed as well. I defer to the individual commits for the exact details of the changes.

The behavior of the `FileInPath` with respect to the typical cases of `CMSSW_SEARCH_PATH` and `CMSSW_BASE`/`CMSSW_RELEASE_BASE`/`CMSSW_DATA_PATH` should remain unchanged.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51757
Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2407

#### PR validation:

Added unit tests pass.
title: Add tests for `edm::FileInPath` and fix number of corner cases
